name_zh: 阿塞拜疆·尼扎米·甘加维：东方诗人与智慧爱情哲学
name_en: Azerbaijan Nizami Ganjavi: Oriental Poet Wisdom Love Philosophy
description_zh: 尼扎米·甘加维 (1141-1209) 波斯文学巨匠，生于甘贾，创作《五部诗集》包括《七美人》《莱莉与麦吉努》等，融合伊斯兰神秘主义、希腊哲学、印度智慧，奠定东方浪漫史诗传统。
description_en: Nizami Ganjavi (1141-1209) Persian literature master, born in Ganja, authored Khamsa including Haft Paykar and Layla Majnun, fused Islamic mysticism, Greek philosophy, Indian wisdom, founded Oriental romantic epic tradition.
reason_zh: 尼扎米代表中世纪伊斯兰世界文学巅峰，展示了跨文明智慧融合如何创造永恒文学典范，其作品超越民族宗教界限成为世界文学共同遗产。
reason_en: Nizami represents medieval Islamic world literary peak, demonstrating how cross-civilizational wisdom fusion creates timeless literary canon, his works transcending ethnic-religious boundaries becoming world literature common heritage.
steps_zh: 研究尼扎米生平与中世纪甘贾文化环境
分析《五部诗集》结构与寓言哲学内核
探讨《莱莉与麦吉努》神圣爱情与苏菲主义融合
评估《七美人》七公主故事政治智慧寓言
总结尼扎米对后世波斯乌尔都奥斯曼文学的影响
steps_en: Study Nizami life and medieval Ganja cultural environment
Analyze Khamsa structure and allegorical philosophy core
Explore Layla Majnun sacred love and Sufism fusion
Evaluate Haft Paykar seven princesses political wisdom allegory
Summarize Nizami influence on later Persian Urdu Ottoman literature
expected_zh: 掌握尼扎米诗歌哲学核心与跨文明智慧融合机制，理解东方浪漫史诗传统的奠基意义，评估其对世界文学爱情智慧母题的永恒贡献。
expected_en: Master Nizami poetic philosophy core and cross-civilizational wisdom fusion mechanism, understand Oriental romantic epic tradition founding significance, evaluate its eternal contribution to world literature love wisdom motifs.
case_zh: 1141 尼扎米生于甘贾；1170s 创作《宝藏》开篇；1188 《莱莉与麦吉努》完成；1209 逝世。东方诗人智慧爱情哲学永存。
case_en: 1141 Nizami born in Ganja; 1170s Makhzan al-Asrar begun; 1188 Layla Majnun completed; 1209 death. Oriental poet wisdom love philosophy endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Oriental romantic epic founder; cross-civilizational wisdom fusion; world literature heritage
artistic_legacy: 是: 古典波斯诗歌/浪漫史诗
